stories.title: Harvard University data breach exposed info of 851,000 accounts
stories.summary: Hackers who breached Harvard University's Alumni Affairs and Development systems in November 2025 stole data linked to more than 850,000 unique email addresses, according to breach notification service Have I Been Pwned.

stories.title: Over 1,000 GitLab servers vulnerable to ongoing RCE attacks
stories.summary: Over 1,000 Internet-exposed GitLab servers are still unpatched against a maximum-severity flaw actively exploited in remote code execution attacks.

stories.title: Critical Langflow Flaws Could Let Unauthenticated Attackers Run Code on Servers
stories.summary: Two critical flaws in Langflow could let a remote attacker with no account bypass authentication or run arbitrary code, IBM said last week. Langflow is an open-source tool for building AI agents and workflows, and its vulnerability reports go to IBM. stories.title: Attackers Exploit Critical Siemens IoT2050 Flaw to Plant Remote Command Backdoors
stories.summary: A maximum-severity security flaw impacting Siemens SIMATIC IoT2050 Advanced devices has come under active exploitation, VulnCheck has revealed. The vulnerability, tracked as CVE-2026-58115 (CVSS score: 10.0), is a case of missing authentication for a critical function that could be exploited by an unauthenticated remote attacker to run arbitrary code. stories.title: Revolve Data Breach Impacts at Least 200,000 People
stories.summary: Hackers accessed its online shopping platform and stole customers’ personal and payment card information.

stories.title: ⚡ Weekly Recap: Critical CVEs, Linux DDoS Botnet, Device-Code Phishing, Android Spyware and More

stories.title: Ivanti patches two more Connect Secure zero-days chained in attacks
stories.summary: Ivanti released security updates to patch two more Connect Secure (ICS) remote access gateway flaws that have been chained in zero-day attacks since at least October 1.

stories.title: Red Hat Patches 9.8-Rated Linux TCP RCE Flaw While Ubuntu Releases Fixes for Testing
